summary: Douglas County lookout: a 50-ft tower and house put up in 1956, discontinued in 1975, dismantled in 1976. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 50-ft treated timber tower with a 14 x 14-ft lookout house
facts.status_note: Tower dismantled in 1976; parts salvaged for the new Mt. Scott lookout. Register says now gone.

events.note: 50-ft tower purchased and completed that fall, with a 3/4-mile road built to it; register and firelookout.com date the lookout to 1956
Lookout house finished, per the Forest Lookouts history of the 1957 Douglas FPA report
Lookout discontinued, per the Forest Lookouts history; the register photo caption runs 1956 to 1975
Tower dismantled; parts salvaged for use in the new Mt. Scott lookout

evidence.quote: Built in 1956, this 50' wooden flat live-in tower is now gone.

evidence.supports: 1956 purchase of 50-ft treated timber tower and 14 x 14 lookout house
evidence.quote: A new 14 x 14 lookout house and a 50 foot treated timber tower was purchased for Old Fairview.

evidence.supports: three-quarter-mile road built to the lookout
evidence.quote: 3/4 mile of new road constructed to the new lookout on Old Fairview.

evidence.supports: tower finished fall 1956; house to follow before next season
evidence.quote: The tower was completed this fall and the house will be built before fire season next year.
The lookout house on Old Fairview was finished

evidence.supports: dismantled in 1976; parts salvaged for the new Mt. Scott lookout
evidence.quote: The lookout was dismantled and parts were salvaged for use in the new Mt. Scott lookout.

evidence.supports: register says the lookout is now gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1956. The Douglas FPA reports, as transcribed on the Forest Lookouts page, show the tower completed in 1956 and the lookout house finished in 1957. The story gives 1956 for the tower and 1957 for the house.

notes_for_editor: No source describes the site today, and the story says so. The 1956-1976 history comes from a Weebly transcription of Douglas FPA annual reports, not the reports themselves. Brief record is correct (gone, FFLOS registration 2011-03-26, 50 ft = 15.2 m); no corrections. Access is left unset because no source gives it.
